dedupe_keys.name: ireland rescued river flow and water levels 1939 2021

description: The Irish hydrometric data-rescue team publishes extended water-level and river-flow records for eight catchments modified by arterial drainage. PANGAEA metadata give coverage from 1 October 1939 to 30 September 2021. Station folders contain ASCII daily absolute levels and flows with quality codes, plus readme files explaining rating curves, rescue choices and missing periods. Three folders add chart-rescue metadata. The public archive is free under CC-BY-4.0. The article counts about 150 added station-years relative to previously available records. Early flows depend on historical rating curves, sometimes extended retrospectively before the first gauging, so the reconstructed series have distinct uncertainties from direct measurements. The records can calibrate rainfall-runoff, drainage and flood simulations where twentieth-century pre-intervention conditions matter. They complement data-hydrosheds-hydrorivers-hydrobasins with measured catchment time series, not only network geometry. The paper describes an HY2020 endpoint, while the repository states 2021; the repository period is used here. No data rows were downloaded.
name: Ireland rescued river flow and water levels, 1939–2021
